test: SPEC-030 runtime verification — 1000-photo delivery with immutable staging + sha256 manifest

setup.generator: BuildPhotos.py --staging (Astra stdlib JPEG encoder, ~9.9KB per 800x600 grayscale photo)
setup.contentapp_io_arg: staging path passed directly as ContentApp IO argument (Astra Phase 0 decision)

result.byte_integrity: PERFECT — every received file byte-identical to what was published

findings_during_test: First attempt delivered OLD content (288KB files): NRNCS cache from the morning run served stale photos.
Second defect: Repository kept old files until both NRNCS cache and Repository1 dir were cleared and the full stack restarted in strict order (PGCS 36 -> PGCS 61 -> NRNCS -> Repository -> Source).
Discovery cycle takes ~3-5 min after full restart (periodic expositions); expect this in future test plans.
The 288KB-vs-9.9KB discrepancy is how the stale-cache serving was DETECTED — the manifest method works.
action_item: NRNCS cache invalidation on content update / subscription chain stale-serving is a product defect candidate — register as issue for Astra (relates to SPEC-020/022/023 lineage).
